Chapter 6811: Just A Little Thing

Chapter 6811: Just A Little Thing

“The shrine appears to be an heirloom, nothing more, why do you want it?” Blaze Ancestor asked.

“I’m afraid the answer would frighten you.” Eagle God said.

“Do tell.” He spoke calmly, feeling rather curious about the potential treasure. After all, if it were useful, Tinyleaf wouldn’t have fallen so far. Furthermore, it would have been noticed in the past.

The citizens of Tinyleaf were just as confused. Although they have worshipped this shrine for generations, they didn’t notice anything miraculous or special about it.

“I suppose I don’t mind letting you all know. We didn’t come for this shrine specifically but rather, Devouring Abyss sensed something essential in Tinyleaf. After a full excavation, we determined that the thing with divinity was taken away.” Eagle God said.

“Excavated?” The city lord and the others became startled, realizing that Frenzy had indeed returned after their departure. Now, their home was destroyed.

Nevertheless, this meant that they had made the correct decision. At least everyone evacuated and stayed alive.

“Devouring Abyss.” Blaze Ancestor’s expression changed.

Stygian currently had three behemoths - Gu Chun’s Dark Realm, Fallen Ten, and Devouring Abyss.

In the past, Fallen Ten was the main fighting force of the alliance. All members had to obey. Their lord was none other than Zhao Dachui.

Unfortunately for this faction, Zhao Dachui and the ten beings known as Devouring Immortal Monarchs were killed in battle.

All feared these immortals. Zhao Dachui, in particular, was rumored to have reached the shore. However, since he didn’t have a paramita shell, he was considered the strongest primordial immortal instead.

Now, Gu Chun’s Dark Realm was in charge of the alliance and Stygian. Although Fallen Ten still had immortals, Immortal Emperor Gu Chun could overpower any of them, hence the spread of his rules and Dark Desire.

Of course, Fallen Ten wouldn’t be in charge even in his absence since Devouring Abyss was still stronger.

During Fallen Ten’s prime, Devouring Abyss was a feeble branch. It only rose to prominence after Heaven Pit. Its progenitor, Immortal Devourer, was only one step - a proper legacy - from becoming a primordial immortal.

Some said before falling, Immortal Devourer was a nobody, only pretending to be a part of the alliance. No one knew how this cultivator reached the top. Another argued that the reason for the cultivator’s fall was an attempt to find a legacy artifact.

The third spoke of a great master leading the way. All in all, no one had an exact answer.

However, Devouring Abyss’ involvement startled Blaze Emperor.

“Be smart and hand the shrine over, we have no intention of attacking Golden Lamp but Devouring Abyss demands an answer. If we come back empty-handed, we’ll be punished. What do you think we’ll do to you next?” Eagle God said: “Of course, we have sentiments for this place. I don’t know if Devouring Abyss will be as gentle.”

“Eagle God, intimidation is useless. The old Fallen Ten couldn’t destroy Golden Lamp or force us to submit; this applies to Devouring Abyss as well.” Thunder Emperor said.

“Hahaha, if you’re feeling suicidal, don’t blame us.” Eagle God said seriously.

“Thunder might fall but our lamp will never extinguish.” She said.

“Never extinguished!” The members of Thunder Kingdom roared thunderously, true to their kingdom’s name.

“Fine, I’ll kill you first.” Eagle God spread his wings, revealing blade-like feathers.

“If you have the ability.” She raised her spear and lightning coursed through the weapon and her armor plates.

“Boom!” Both released their imperial auras to everyone’s horror
